items.title: Ron Carter — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Helen Merrill. Wonderful singer. ... Made a nice duo record with her, a wonderful record.

ctx.x: No, no, no. Different person. Kimery: Esther Merrill?

Yeah. Yeah. So, when I finally reached him, he was curious as to how two basses were going to work out. I said, "Kenny, I got this girl … just get on this bus." And he said, "Okay." And we were together five, six years.
